name: @repo/connectors
description: The MCP/connectors capability behind code mode: the executor daemon manager (checksum-pinned GitHub-release install via @repo/installer, spawn/ready/reap lifecycle under ~/.inteligir/executor), the typed executor HTTP client, connector install/uninstall orchestration (ports-injected — the host binds openExternal), the bundled Google OAuth client, and the dev-only emulate-connectors override (gated on the boot-computed dev-flag bit, @repo/bridge/dev-flags). Never imports server/electron code.
